newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CNB FIXES CROWN -2.80 PCT VS MARK/USD BASKET.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CNB FIXES CROWN -2.80 PCT VS MARK/USD BASKET.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown at 30.475 to the dollar after Friday's fixing at 30.824, and at 18.078 to the mark from 18.220.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of the central bank's mark/dollar basket of -2.80 percent, after a deviation of -3.74 on Friday.
During the minute at which the central bank calculated today's fixing, the crown was trading on the interbank market at -3.34 percent.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (0940) GMT), and is within plus/minus 7.5 percent of the mark/dollar basket midpoint calculated between 11:30:00 and 11:30:59 CET.
